moreInformation.title: What information can my Family & Friends see?
moreInformation.description:
Once a Guest accepts your invitation to connect, you will see them in your Family & Friends list. After connecting, you will be able to:
  • Link reservations, tickets and purchases to each other
  • Add and manage activities for each other
  • View each other's full name, age (or "18+"), selected character image, Disney PhotoPass photos and other digital content and plans*
  • See the full name, character images and ages of each other's family and friends. The Family & Friends of your connection will also be able to see the full names, character images and ages of you and the Guests you manage.*
*If you choose not to share your Family & Friends list in your "Account Settings", your full name, character image and age will be visible only to the Guests to whom you directly connect, and not to their Family & Friends. Choosing not to share your list will also prevent the profiles you manage from being visible to your connections and their Family & Friends. You can separately choose whether to share your Disney PhotoPass photos and all your plans with a connection by selecting "Edit Settings" on your Family & Friends list.

duplicateProfiles.title: Duplicate Profiles
duplicateProfiles.description:
It looks like you have multiple profiles with the same name and age on your Family & Friends list.

If these profiles were created for the same person, we recommend combining them so that it’s easier to manage plans and entitlements for that person. Plus, it helps avoid any potential confusion that could arise when juggling multiple profiles.

Don’t worry! When you combine 2 profiles, all reservations, tickets, plans, purchases, MagicBands, cards, Disney PhotoPass photos, affiliations and Family & Friends connections linked to each profile will transfer onto one profile and nothing will be lost.

Please note: If one of the profiles is managed by another person, they will need to approve your request to combine profiles. Also, keep in mind that:
  • You will need to choose one person to manage the combined profile.
  • That person will be in charge of editing the profile, adjusting settings and approving connections moving forward.
  • The settings of the profile they manage will carry over to the combined profile.
  • Both of you will still be able to make and manage plans for the combined profile as long as you remain connected to it.

fly-terms-and-conditions-policy-acknowle.main_body:
The Disability Access Service (DAS) is intended to accommodate Guests who, due to a developmental disability like autism or similar, are unable to wait in a conventional queue for an extended period of time. This service allows Guests to schedule a return time that is comparable to the current queue wait for the given attraction. To maximize the benefits of this service, Guests should plan ahead using available wait time data, ride locations, and attraction access options to develop a tentative plan for their visit. This service does not provide immediate attraction access.

Terms and Conditions
  1. Your scheduled return time does not provide immediate access upon your return.
  2. You may not have more than one active attraction DAS return time at a time.
  3. Park and attraction hours are subject to change without notice.
  4. Attractions may close without notice.
  5. Not valid for admission to any Theme Park, experience, service or facility.
  6. All Guests must meet boarding requirements.
  7. The Guest for which DAS is being requested must be present during registration and experience the attraction when redeeming a DAS return time.
  8. When utilizing this service, it is possible to experience waits greater than the posted wait time.
  9. Your agreement to these Terms and Conditions is effective for as long as you have this service.
  10. I understand that after an individualized discussion regarding my personal circumstances I may be offered DAS, alternative accommodations, or no accommodation at all. I agree that any lawsuit I may file, or participate in, challenging this decision, the individualized discussion, or the overall process itself, shall be conducted only on an individual basis and not as a plaintiff or class member in a purported class, consolidated or representative action or proceeding.
  11. The company reserves the right to change the Terms and Conditions of this service without notice, at which time you will need to accept the updated Terms and Conditions.
  12. By accepting DAS below, you acknowledge that the recipient of this service has a disability requiring the services of this program and you knowingly and voluntarily agree to and accept the Terms and Conditions.
  13. This service is revocable, non-transferable, not for commercial use, void if altered and subject to change without notice.

I acknowledge and understand that DAS provides valuable benefits intended for Guests (and their party) who, due to a developmental disability like autism or similar, are unable to wait in a conventional queue for an extended period of time and that if Disney later determines that any of the statements I made in the process of obtaining DAS services are not true, I will be permanently barred from entering the Walt Disney World Resort and my previously-purchased annual passes, tickets and other park products and services will be forfeited and not refunded.

wallet.title: Web and App Purchases
wallet.desc:
Store up to 6 credit cards to your Disney account and save time when making select website and app purchases. Learn more.

The credit card stored in your Disney account for select purchases is separate from the credit card associated with an annual pass purchased using the Monthly Payments Program for Florida residents. If you wish to update a Monthly Payments Program credit card, please call (888) 701-4100.

pin_status.title: Disney Resort Hotel Guests
pin_status.desc:
If you're staying at a Disney Resort hotel, you can charge incidental and merchandise purchases to your hotel account using a MagicBand or Key to the World Card by setting up a payment method at your Resort hotel Front Desk or during online check-in.

You'll also need a 4-digit PIN to use with your MagicBand or Key to the World Card.

errorExplain.fl:
Not to worry, you can present valid proof of Florida residency when you pick up your tickets or passes at any Walt Disney World theme park ticket window.

To pick up the order, you'll need to show a valid government-issued photo ID and your confirmation email. If picking up tickets, you'll also need to show the original payment card used during this purchase.

mep.title: Enter Your Main Entrance Pass Info
mep.description:
Enter your last name exactly as it appears on your pass, and also the 12- or 17-digit ID number on the back of your pass. (See example below.) Or you may enter the 8-digit PERNR number from your company ID.

If you have a spouse or domestic partner, they may also have a pass. But you should enter only the information for your pass. If no entitlements are found when you select “Continue” below, please check that the information you entered is correct.

Note: Providing your pass information will link any valid Main Entrance Pass or Self Admission entitlements you have at the Disneyland Resort and Walt Disney World Resort to the Disneyland and Walt Disney World website and app, respectively.

secondary.title: Assign Your Spouse/Partner Pass
secondary.description:
For your spouse or partner to use their spouse pass to make park reservations, they must be a connected registered Guest on the Walt Disney World website—i.e., they have their own Disney account that is linked to yours.

If your spouse or partner does not have a Disney account or needs to link their account to yours, you may send them an email invitation by selecting the “Add a Guest” option in the Assign Pass field below. Upon accepting this invitation, their pass(es) will be linked to the Disneyland and Walt Disney World website and app (depending on eligibility).

When you assign your spouse/partner pass, you are accepting the Cast Member Terms & Conditions governing Cast Member admission to the Disneyland Resort and Walt Disney World Resort theme parks on your on your spouse/partner’s behalf and will be responsible for their use of the pass.
